title: Commission approves the acquisition of certain shareholding in Sorting Hat Technologies Private Limited and its merger with and into upGrad Education Private Limited.
Commission approves the merger of 51 Malabar Group’s companies with and into Malabar Gold and Diamonds Limited.

Commission approves the acquisition of equity shares amounting to 14.286% of the Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited by the Indriya Limited.
